title: Fourteen Years of Change Transform Toronto’s East Bayfront
summary:
UrbanToronto Forum contributor mburrrrr recently created an extraordinary post documenting nearly 14 years of growth in Toronto’s East Bayfront from his Downtown condo. His photographs trace the transformation of this strip of the waterfront from 2013 to 2026, as warehouses, parking lots, and open parcels give way to a neighbourhood of homes, parks, and commercial/institutional spaces along Queens Quay East.
